stemMd: Instead of repainting the entire mural, conservators repaired only the damaged edges; their intervention was deliberately ______.
explanationMd: Instead of contrasts extensive repainting with limited repair. Restrained describes the intentionally modest scope, while the alternatives introduce unsupported claims or reverse that contrast.

distractorRationale.e: This contradicts repairing only limited areas.
distractorRationale.b: The extent of intervention does not establish reversibility.
distractorRationale.d: Nothing says the work was unplanned.
distractorRationale.c: Limited intervention is not described as showy.
